tools.name: superfaktura_get_company
tools.description: The company the API key is working in (name, IČO, DIČ, IČ DPH, address, VAT-payer flag, bank accounts) and the remaining API quota (SuperFaktura's fair-use policy is 1000 requests per day and 31000 per month; every tool call here uses one request). Good first call. With all_companies=true also the o

tools.name: superfaktura_list_invoices
tools.description: List issued documents with client, items, totals and payment status. type selects the document kind (default regular = ordinary invoices; also proforma, estimate = quote, order, cancel = credit note, delivery, draft, reverse_order; several allowed). Without a date filter SuperFaktura returns only th

tools.name: superfaktura_get_invoice
tools.description: One document (invoice, proforma, quote ...) with its header (number, dates, status, amounts, currency, symbols, comments), client, items, VAT summary, payments and related documents. The public access token and payment links of the document are not returned. GET /invoices/view/{id}.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_clients
tools.description: List the address book (clients and suppliers) with contact data and totals. search matches name, IČO, DIČ, IČ DPH, bank account, e-mail, address, city, phone, note and tags. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /clients/index.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_get_client
tools.description: One client with address, tax ids, bank data, default currency/due days/discount and statistics. GET /clients/view/{id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_contact_persons
tools.description: The contact persons (name, e-mail, phone) stored for one client. GET /contact_people/getContactPeople/{client_id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_expenses
tools.description: List received documents (expenses: received invoices, bills, internal documents) with amounts, VAT, supplier and payment status. status: issued (new), partially_paid, paid, overdue. Without a date filter SuperFaktura applies its default period; pass created_period='all' for everything. Paged: pass n

tools.name: superfaktura_get_expense
tools.description: One expense with its items, VAT rates, payments and supplier. Attachments are not returned. GET /expenses/view/{id}.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_expense_categories
tools.description: The expense category tree (id, name, parent) for the category_id of expenses. GET /expenses/expense_categories.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts as stored in SuperFaktura (bank name, IBAN, SWIFT, default flag). GET /bank_accounts/index.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_bank_moves
tools.description: Bank transactions imported into SuperFaktura (date, amount, currency, variable symbol, counter account, matching state), newest first by default. Filter by date range, credit/debit or amount. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /accounts/index.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_cash_registers
tools.description: The company's cash registers with currency, number of entries and current balance (read only). GET /cash_registers/getDetails.

tools.name: superfaktura_get_cash_register
tools.description: One cash register with currency, number of entries and current balance (read only). GET /cash_registers/view/{id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_stock_items
tools.description: List warehouse items (name, SKU, unit, price, VAT, quantity in stock). search matches name, SKU and description; sku matches the SKU. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /stock_items/index.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_get_stock_item
tools.description: One warehouse item with SKU, price, VAT, purchase price and quantity in stock. GET /stock_items/view/{id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_stock_movements
tools.description: The stock log of one item (quantity changes, notes, related invoice or expense). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /stock_items/movements/{id}.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_tags
tools.description: The tags (id and name) usable on invoices, expenses and clients. GET /tags/index.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_sequences
tools.description: The document numbering sequences per document type (id, name, mask, next formatted number, default flag); sequence ids are used when creating documents. GET /sequences/index.json.

tools.name: superfaktura_list_countries
tools.description: SuperFaktura's country ids with ISO code and EU flag, for the country_id of clients. GET /countries/index/view_full:1.

tools.name: superfaktura_get_response_by_checksum
tools.description: If a superfaktura_create_invoice call timed out, fetch the reply of the ORIGINAL request by the checksum it was sent with (kept 3 months), so the document is not created twice. GET /api_logs/getResponseByChecksum/{checksum}.

tools.name: superfaktura_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new client to the SuperFaktura address book (only the name is required). Nothing is sent to the client. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two clients, so check superfaktura_list_clients first. POST /clients/create.

tools.name: superfaktura_add_contact_person
tools.description: WRITE: adds a contact person (name and e-mail, optional phone) to an existing client. Nothing is sent to that person. Not idempotent. POST /contact_people/add/api:1.

tools.name: superfaktura_create_tag
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new tag name (usable on invoices, expenses and clients in the SuperFaktura app). A duplicate name is refused by SuperFaktura. POST /tags/add.

tools.name: superfaktura_create_expense
tools.description: WRITE: records a received document (expense) with ONE total amount and VAT rate, e.g. a supplier invoice or a bill. It is created unpaid: no payment is recorded and nothing is sent. No attachments. Not idempotent: calling twice records two expenses. POST /expenses/add.

tools.name: superfaktura_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: creates ONE document in SuperFaktura for the user to review: type draft (concept, default), estimate (quote), order or proforma. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: superfaktura_get_invoice, superfaktura_create_client, superfaktura_create_invoice · Private data: superfaktura_get_company, superfaktura_list_invoices, superfaktura_get_invoice, superfaktura_list_clients, superfaktura_list_contact_persons, superfaktura_list_expenses, superfaktura_list_sequences, superfaktura_get_response_by_checksum, superfaktura_add_contact_person, superfaktura_create_expense, superfaktura_create_invoice · Public sink: superfaktura_create_client, superfaktura_add_contact_person, superfaktura_create_tag, superfaktura_create_expense, superfaktura_create_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: superfaktura_get_invoice, superfaktura_create_client, superfaktura_create_invoice · Private data: superfaktura_get_company, superfaktura_list_invoices, superfaktura_get_invoice, superfaktura_list_clients, superfaktura_list_contact_persons, superfaktura_list_expenses, superfaktura_list_sequences, superfaktura_get_response_by_checksum, superfaktura_add_contact_person, superfaktura_create_expense, superfaktura_create_invoice · Public sink: superfaktura_create_client, superfaktura_add_contact_person, superfaktura_create_tag, superfaktura_create_expense, superfaktura_create_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
